selected_evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker runs as managed service inventory-worker under dedicated inventorysvc account
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed binary and absence of prior user/service, then created inventorysvc, installed and started inventory-worker.service; systemctl status and ps show it active and running as inventorysvc

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (e8afb731-420c-4162-a989-583aca271335) and confirmed inventory-worker active with process running

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: restart acknowledgement and disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded sudo reboot which returned acknowledgement immediately; subsequent exec call failed with connection reset, confirming the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: changed boot identity after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Polling succeeded once node1 came back, returning a new boot_id (3601e4ff-0a6f-4865-b9bc-44d47af33ca9), differing from the pre-restart value, proving an actual reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: post-restart recovery of service and account
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart check shows same new boot_id, inventory-worker enabled and active with a fresh process (PID 654) running as inventorysvc, and the inventorysvc account still present

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "=== create system user inventorysvc ==="
sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventorysvc
id inventorysvc

echo "=== write unit file ==="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service > /dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory Worker (OS comparison worker)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT

echo "=== reload, enable, start ==="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-worker

echo "=== verify status ==="
sleep 2
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-worker
sudo -n systemctl status inventory-worker --no-pager

echo "=== verify running user ==="
ps -o pid,user,cmd -C os-comparison-worker
